presentation.label: DT-FM
presentation.summary: Four-operator FM synth machine for the original Digitakt, with the stock AMP, filter, mixer and sends preserved.
presentation.overview: DT-FM replaces the earlier Sophie-based voice with a dedicated four-operator FM engine. It keeps the Digitakt’s usual signal path while adding its own SRC machine page and four FM operators that survive project/session state.
highlights: Adds a four-operator FM machine for the original Digitakt.
Keeps the normal AMP, filter, mixer and effects path intact.
Supports both OS 1.53 and 1.54 builds while reusing the stock patch sites.
Works with machine-pages for the combined SRC panel and machine selection flow.
usage: On an audio track using the default single-shot machine, press FUNC + SRC to open machine assignment.
Highlight DT-FM and press YES to assign it; the track opens DT-FM's SRC controls.
Choose an operator with encoder D, then adjust its ratio with C and level with E; shape its envelope with F and G.
Play trigs to use the FM voice, and press STOP to stop playback. Use the usual AMP page for note shaping.

controls.name: SRC A — TUNE
controls.doc: Pitch of the selected FM operator or group.

controls.name: SRC B — ALGO
controls.doc: Pick the FM routing algorithm and draw the operator graph.

controls.name: SRC C — RATIO
controls.doc: Frequency ratio for the selected operator.

controls.name: SRC D — OP
controls.doc: Select which of the four operators is edited.

controls.name: SRC E — LEVEL
controls.doc: Set carrier output or modulation depth depending on operator role.

controls.name: SRC G — DECAY
controls.doc: Set the envelope decay time or hold mode.

controls.name: SRC H — CHAR
controls.doc: Adjust operator 4 feedback and overall brightness.

limitations: A limited Modwerk hardware performance observation is recorded in TESTING.md; it does not replace worst-case DSP, memory, persistence or full hardware qualification.
The upstream author’s hardware and DSP validation remains the main qualification record.

load.display: 6 tracks before aggregate CPU reached 100% (one OS 1.54 run)
load.conditions: One approximately 5-minute maintainer-reported Digitakt 1 OS 1.54 run with FAST AUDIO, Digi Health, Digi Utils and Machine Pages; six DT-FM tracks played before System Info showed 100% CPU. Aggregate threshold only: no repeat/project details or per-module/worst-case DSP measurement. OS 1.53 untested. See TESTING.md.

hardware.summary: With FAST audio enabled, six simultaneous DT-FM tracks played in a Modwerk-built firmware containing Digi Health, Digi Utils and Machine Pages before Digi Health System Info showed CPU usage at 100%.
limitations: One approximately five-minute performance observation; no repeat runs or test-project details were recorded.
The System Info CPU threshold is not a per-module DSP-cycle or worst-case load measurement.
Other OS releases, module combinations, persistence, reboot, sampling and broader hardware behavior were not tested.

tests.summary: A limited owner-reported Digitakt 1 OS 1.54 performance test is recorded in TESTING.md: six DT-FM tracks with FAST audio enabled and Digi Health, Digi Utils and Machine Pages installed, before System Info showed 100% CPU. This does not qualify worst-case DSP load, memory, persistence, sampling or general hardware behavior.
